Please join me THIS MONDAY in Jacksonville for a Veterans Community Roundtable Q&A event at Veterans United Craft Brewery.

WHAT: Meet and Greet and Q&A
WHEN: Monday March 30th at 10:00 AM
WHERE: 899 Western Way, Unit 104,
Jacksonville, FL

RSVP REQUIRED: BYRONDONALDS.COM/VETS330

I'm honored to have the support of @CVA_Action.

Veterans sacrificed so much to protect the American Dream, and I'll never stop fighting to make that dream a reality for every Floridian. 

To our veteran and military families in Florida, thank you for your service, your sacrifice, and your support. Florida is already the greatest state in the nation and together, we'll work to keep it that way and build something even better for the next generation.

It was great to meet with the members of the @FloridaAtlantic College Republicans, University President Adam Hasner & @JuanPorrasFL.

Thank you to all of the patriots who made our event possible & thank you to law enforcement for keeping us safe.

The future of Florida is bright.

Thank you to everyone who joined us this morning on the campus of Miami Dade College.

Together, we discussed the future of education in Florida, academic excellence, and our bold vision for the Sunshine State☀️🇺🇸
LIVE: Excellence in Education Roundtable - Miami nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1Xxygmzvo…

District 14: polls are open to vote @JosieTomkow tomorrow from 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM!

In the House, Josie delivered — lower costs for families, tax cuts, securing our border, and defending your Second Amendment rights. As your Senator, she’ll continue fighting for you.

Tomorrow is Election Day for Trump-endorsed Jon Maples!

Make sure to head to the polls tomorrow from 7:00 am – 7:00 pm to vote for President Trump’s choice for District 87.

 Vote Jon Maples!

Video

God bless the heroic men and women of @MiamiDadeFire Engine 3.

Thank you for all that you do to keep Floridians safe!
Thank you to Apostle Guillermo Maldonado for welcoming me into King Jesus Ministry this morning✝️

I gave my life to Christ at 21 years old.

I spent 12 years of my life as a youth leader at my church in Naples.

It was an honor to join King Jesus Ministry this morning in Miami.

Video

Thank you to the patriots who joined us last night at Mar-a-Lago for the 26th annual Palm Beach GOP Lincoln Day Dinner.

Thank you to @realDonaldTrump for opening your home to us and for your kind words.

With unapologetic conservatism, we will take Florida to the NEXT LEVEL☀️🇺🇸
